title: Refinance Down-Payment Points by Tier and Late-Charge Standing — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
**Risk schedule — refinance down payment by standing.** When the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is refinanced, the contract carries percentage points of the balloon amount toward the refinance down payment according to its tier and recent late charges:

| Contract | Percentage points carried for standing |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 4 or Tier 5 | 10.0 |
| Tier 2 or Tier 3 with at least one balloon late charge assessed in the 12 calendar months ending on the payment date | 7.5 |
| Tier 1 or Tier 1+, or Tier 2 or Tier 3 with no late charge in those months | None |

The percentage points are percentage points of the balloon amount. A window of 12 calendar months ending on the payment date takes in the dates on or before the payment date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it; whole calendar months are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.

*Hypothetical:* a Tier 3 contract whose only late charge was assessed 11 months before the payment date carries 7.5 percentage points; a Tier 4 contract with no late charge carries 10.0.
